what: The fixes the self-audit's mutation campaign forced (the pre-registration: a false certification is a defect, fixed, the fix recorded beside the mutant, the mutant kept, the count reported, never deleted). Each entry names the finding, the record and commit it was found at, the mutants it covered by id, and the fix; tools/run-selfaudit-mutations.js reads this file, marks each covered mutant that now comes out as required with fixedFrom, and reports per fix how many are as required now and which are not. Nothing here moves a definition of the pre-registration.

fixes.finding: the easota ledger's word (WITNESSED → the register's CERTIFIED) was about the bytes witnessing a value; the printed digits were a field beside it (printedAgrees), gated only by the easota page build and the paper numbers. A printed value moved one unit in its last digit past the bytes stayed CERTIFIED on the 15 easota rows with a printed value and a WITNESSED decision, while tools/run-mc100-einstein.js refutes the same for the mc100 rows.

fix.what: instruments/easota/word.js composes the word in one place: WITNESSED with a printed value the exact value does not reproduce → MISPRINTED → the register's REFUTED, kind not-from-the-published-data, the exact value certified beside it; tools/run-easota-ledger.js and instruments/selfaudit/shapes.js both call it; tools/run-claims-ledger.js maps MISPRINTED; the easota page and battery know the word. No row of the pinned records changes word; the ledger record's grammar string gains MISPRINTED at the next re-pin (Phase 5).

fixes.finding: a malformed input — a factor matrix with a short row (the rank claim no longer matching the columns), an object that is not n vectors in R^d, a weight row without 20 weights — was answered REFUTED (the tensor instrument's shape checks; the mc100-einstein decider's shape checks, kind not-from-the-published-data) where the vocabulary of instruments/verdict.js and the pre-registration say REFUSED: a claim the instrument cannot decide, not a false one.

fix.what: instruments/strassen/tensor.js: the four shape checks of audit() and of auditZi() answer REFUSED with the same reason (the identity failing under both layouts stays REFUTED); families/strassen-audit.js and tools/run-mc100-tensors.js already map the instrument's REFUSED to the register's; tools/run-mc100-einstein.js: an object that is not n vectors in R^d and a weight row without 20 weights are REFUSED, kind none. The strassen battery's forged-rank red control expects REFUSED with its reason. No row of the pinned records changes word.

fixes.finding: the polynomial maps' partial path (F7: the collision is evaluated, the determinant rests on the paper's lemma) read a term whose exponent tuple is short by one entry as if the missing exponent were 0 — P.ev (instruments/polymaps/poly.py) paired the point with the tuple by zip, which stops at the shorter, and nothing checked a tuple's length when a map was built — and answered PARTIAL where the pre-registration requires REFUSED for a malformed object. The paths that expand the determinant refused the same term only by accident (diff() indexes every variable). Kept open on the record at the freeze (the pre-registration's amendment of 2026-10-22, point 2) and in DEBT.md until 2026-11-11.

fix.what: the shape is checked at the door, before any arithmetic reads the object: poly.from_object(n, comps) and poly.points_from(n, points) refuse (ValueError 'REFUSED: …') a map without n components, a term that is not a pair, an exponent tuple that is not exactly n non-negative integers, a coefficient or coordinate that is not an integer or a rational written as text, a point without n coordinates; decide.py (load_maps, keller, my_field, the F7 and Phi blocks), tools/run-mc100-station.py and the harness instruments/selfaudit/polymaps.js (every branch) go through them, and P.ev itself refuses a short tuple or a short point, so the zip cannot truncate however a P was built. Five red controls in instruments/polymaps/battery.py. No row of the pinned records changes word; certs/polymaps-ledger.json and certs/mc100-station-v2.json were re-derived (the decider's sha256 and the stamps). The mutant was re-decided in place by tools/run-selfaudit-mutations.js --amend (the record's amended entry keeps the first decision), the nine polymaps rows re-decided in a dry run beside it: every other word identical.
